title: The anti-rug "fork" test never uses the fork for the detector: it mocks the ethers Contract layer, never deploys RugPull.sol (contrary to its header), synthesises the event logs, and mocks the exit to succeed; only the HORSE case reads one real receipt from the fork, and even there the reserves the detector sees are test-controlled

evidence.note: header: RugPull.sol modes "each deployed against a hardhat fork ... executeRug emits the configured V2/V3 event(s)"
vi.mock("ethers") replaces Contract with a dispatcher returning test-controlled getReserves / totalSupply / liquidity / quote / balanceOf
comment: the tests run "without requiring an actual deploy + executeRug round-trip (which the Contract mocking precludes)"
synthetic RugPull and destination addresses; the log is built by makeV2BurnLog / makeV3CollectLog
HORSE: the only real fork read is the LP-removal receipt (destination resolved from topic[2])
HORSE: supply and reserves are then mocked to the drained values and the Burn log is re-synthesised
mode 4: the held-burn assertion runs only if a test hook exists

sibling_sites_checked: Every place RugPull.sol is used: compiled by hardhat.config.ts:18-29; its artifact is loaded at antiRugDetector.fork.test.ts:464-470 and only asserted to have bytecode (:530-541); no ContractFactory deploy of it anywhere in the slice. The integration sibling with the same mocks is AUD-TESTI-005.
severity_rationale: S2: the fork-labelled anti-rug proof mocks the very chain reads the detector depends on and the exit it triggers, so it adds no real-path evidence and hides the registered anti-rug S1s (AUD-ANTIRUG-003/-004).
recommendation: Phase 25/28: deploy RugPull.sol (or replay HORSE) on the fork with the real ethers Contract, let the detector read the fork's reserves and logs through a real provider subscription, and run a real (fork) exit so refusal and retry are observable.
affected_cases: RugPull mode 0..4: detector responds correctly to mode-N event payload
HORSE V2 rug fixture: forkBlockNumber resolved → multi-signal unsafe; missing addresses → skipped per Wave-1 follow-up
escaped_regression: Change the V2 evaluator to read reserves from the wrong pair address (for example the token address): every mode case and the HORSE case stay green because the Contract mock returns the scripted reserves for any address.
